collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A dye pot turns a villager's fingers a deep shade of blue.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A dye pot turns (name1)'s fingers a deep shade of blue. (name1) proudly shows them off to everyone at supper.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: A dye pot turns (name1)'s fingers a deep shade of blue. The blue lasts for days, and (name1) gets used to it.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A dye pot turns (name1)'s fingers a deep shade of blue. A child asks if they can have blue fingers too.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A dye pot turns (name1)'s fingers a deep shade of blue. The cloth turns out beautifully, and the blue fingers seem a fair trade.
